summary: Union County, OR tower built 1936 (100 ft, disputed); sold out of state hands 1977 or 1984; cab removed; listed standing with cab gone, but a 2003 note says it fell over; private, no public access.

facts.design: 100-ft treated timber tower; L-6 cab per FFLOS, 7x7-ft cab per firelookout.com; living quarters and garage (house since replaced)
facts.status_note: Listed as standing with the cab removed (firelookout.org). A 2003 note on Rex's page says the tower, without its cab, fell over. CherylHill lists the status as unknown.

access.note: Privately owned after a sale by the Oregon Department of Forestry (1977 or 1984; sources differ). No public access per FFLOS and firelookout.com.

visit.trail_note: Private land with no public access; the sources list no public visits.

facts.agency: Oregon Department of Forestry until its sale; privately owned since

events.note: Timber lookout built on the site in 1936; CCC crew from the Hilgard camp began construction in August 1936
Gale Mills stationed at the Glass Hill lookout before leaving for Camp Murray
Known lookout personnel: Jeanine Watkins; tower, cabin and garage painted the same year
Plan for 1971 to replace the lookout with a metal tower; no source says whether the replacement happened
Lookout sold to Lynn Steiger for $4,176 (ODF annual report quoted on Rex's page); the 1984 auction date conflicts
ODF sold the site at auction to a private party (FFLOS and firelookout.com)
The tower, without its cab, fell over (Rex's page)
Registered on the Former Fire Lookout Sites register on November 15, 2019

corrections.why: The FFLOS register and firelookout.com both describe a 100-foot tower, about 30.5 m. No source supports 2.1 m.

corrections.current: The tower still stands, but its cab is gone (FFLA).
corrections.proposed: Listed as standing with the cab removed (firelookout.org). A 2003 note says the tower, without its cab, fell over. Unresolved.
corrections.why: The brief's note leaves out the 2003 fall reported on Rex's page.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: 100 ft in FFLOS and firelookout.com; 90 ft in a 1936 newspaper item; 82 ft in a 1936 ECW construction record. Not resolved. height_m uses the 100-ft register figure.
FFLOS says L-6 cab; firelookout.com and the ECW record say a 7x7 cab. The L-6 label may name a design and 7x7 the size. Not resolved.
Rex's page quotes a 1977 ODF report of a sale to Lynn Steiger; FFLOS and firelookout.com say the ODF sold the site at auction in 1984. Not resolved.
firelookout.org lists the tower as standing with the cab removed; Rex's page says the tower fell over in 2003; CherylHill lists the status as Unknown, not standing as the brief said. Not resolved.

notes_for_editor: Main open question is status. firelookout.org (FFLA list) marks the tower Standing* (cab gone); Rex's page says it fell over in 2003; CherylHill lists Unknown, not standing as the brief said. The FFLOS detail page is a former-sites register and does not say the tower is gone. Height is 100 ft in two sources and 90 and 82 ft in 1936 records. The sale year conflicts (1977 via Rex's quote of an ODF report vs 1984 auction). The 1970 replacement plan has no record of happening. The cab removal date is not recorded. Staffing as_of is the last dated personnel record, 1954. A 1937 warden item on Rex's page concerns the Glass Mountain lookout, not Glass Hill, so it was dropped. No photos or recent visit reports were checked; no new photos added.
